config.description: Set-and-forget configuration: which view to embed and how navigation behaves.

viewPath.description: Path of the Perspective view to embed and navigate.

viewParams.description: Parameters passed into the embedded view: [{name, value}].

contentWidth.description: The embedded view's natural width in px — the coordinate space for center/home and the basis for fit.

contentHeight.description: The embedded view's natural height in px.

zoomStep.description: Zoom multiplier per wheel tick / button press (1.05–3).

wheelZoom.description: Zoom with the mouse wheel, toward the cursor.

doubleClickZoom.description: Double-click zooms two steps toward the click point.

showControls.description: Show the zoom / reset / fit buttons.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for the built-in control tooltips (en/fr/de/es/nl/it/pt built in). Empty = English.

flyToMs.description: When a script/binding writes state.zoom/center, the viewport animates there over this many ms (0 = snap).

home.description: The reset target (and initial position while state.zoom is unset): a content-coordinate center point and zoom. x/y -1 = content center; zoom 0 = fit.

x.description: Center x in content coordinates (-1 = content center).

y.description: Center y in content coordinates (-1 = content center).

zoom.description: Zoom factor (0 = fit the whole content).

state.description: Two-way runtime state: navigation writes back here, and writing values drives the viewport (fly-to from bindings/scripts).

center.description: The content point under the viewport middle (two-way) — write it to fly there.

viewState.description: The embedded view's load state: loading / valid / notFound / error / access-denied.
